failure_origin: result_digest_sha256 covered only the mutable TopicBatchResult object, so a recomputed digest could change an item disposition without changing persisted LiteratureBase evidence, processed-input state, seen keys, or manual queue state
root_cause: The durable result did not record or validate the reason that each TopicItemResult disposition was produced. Manual results also had only one-way linkage to the queue, so a queue entry could remain orphaned after the result was changed.
invariant: NEW_IMPORT derives only IMPORTED and requires an observed LiteratureBase record, a matching persisted artifact, and IMPORTED import evidence
EXISTING_OBSERVED derives only IDEMPOTENT and requires an observed LiteratureBase record, artifact, and IDEMPOTENT import evidence
SEEN_OBSERVATION_KEY and PROCESSED_INPUT_REPLAY derive only DUPLICATE from persisted seen-key or prior-batch evidence
PENDING_OBSERVATION derives only PENDING from a persisted PENDING LiteratureBase record and PENDING import evidence
MANUAL_QUEUE derives only MANUAL_REVIEW and requires an exactly matching persisted ManualReviewItem
Every manual queue entry is referenced exactly once by a manual result or a persisted cursor-conflict event

repair.topic_observation: Added durable disposition_evidence per input, result-digest verification, LiteratureBase and ArtifactStore readback checks, prior-batch duplicate checks, aggregate-status checks, bidirectional manual queue closure, and deterministic manual_id validation.
repair.dogfood_archive: Versioned the archive schema and recovery contract, and retained replay checks for reconstructed topic state, complete manual queue entries, case set, budget, source identity, and no-claim/no-trace boundaries.

topic_state.behavior: Legacy or unknown state versions fail closed. The error requires preserving the legacy state and replaying authoritative source batches into a new state root; the loader never rewrites or silently discards the legacy file.

dogfood_archive.behavior: Legacy or unknown archive versions fail closed. The error requires preserving the legacy archive and rerunning the checked-in dogfood inputs; replay never silently upgrades the old archive.

red.details: Persisted mutations recomputed result_digest_sha256 where applicable. IMPORTED to IDEMPOTENT, DUPLICATE, and PENDING, MANUAL_REVIEW to IMPORTED with manual_id cleared and aggregate status changed, and a semantically valid orphan queue entry all fail on reload or archive replay.

green.details: Fresh import, valid idempotent replay, valid pending result, duplicate/conflict routing, manual review, cursor replay, dogfood archive replay, budget checks, and no-claim/no-trace boundaries remain passing.

remaining_integrity_boundary: The local result and archive digests plus persisted-source checks detect the requested replay mutations, but a fully compromised host can rewrite every local state input and recompute every local digest. There is no external trust anchor or production/device evidence in this bounded repair. The pipeline retains the no-claim/no-trace boundary.
acceptance_boundary: This does not accept A4 or T2, does not create a promotion, and establishes no independent mathematical proof or release acceptance.
